content:
sarah: Quick sync — we need a clean handoff to partners for the marketplace + SI joint announcement next Wed. Final compatibility matrix by EOD Fri. Main concerns: which driver/CUDA/ROCm combos we advertise, how we label marketplace images, and a short hotfix/backport plan if partners hit regressions. @matt can you own runtime pins? @jules will handle partner comms and announcement wording.

matt: Yep. Proposing initial recommendation: advertise as 'Verified: NVIDIA driver 540.x + CUDA 12.4' and 'Verified: ROCm 5.6 on upstream kernels we test'. We should keep one older legacy lane (driver 525/CUDA 11.8) for SI customers that can't move. I'll draft the matrix.

jules: I'll ping Kevin at Acme SI today to align on wording and their engineering cutover. They want explicit image tags in marketplace copy and a simple fallback statement.

anita: Security note — any marketplace images we publish need vulnerability scan baseline attached and KMS integration documented. Also include SOC2 contact for enterprise partners.

evan: QA flag — our nightly cluster saw a perf regression on A100 in the 540/CUDA12.4 combo: ~9% tokens/sec drop on long-context infer. Repro steps below. Recommend we include a short mitigation checklist for partners.

evan: ```
# repro (internal perf harness)
export MODEL=redwood-test-13b
python3 perf_client.py --host marketplace-staging --model $MODEL --seq 4096 --batch 8
# check driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv
modinfo nvidia | grep -i version
```

matt: thanks — can you attach the perf traces to the ticket? If it's kernel/driver combo specific we should add a recommended kernel range to the matrix. Also: we'll prepare a minimal hotfix/backport guide with steps for partners to apply a micro-patch or opt into a fallback variant (quantized model artifact) in the marketplace listing.

kevin-acme: thx for the heads up. From our side SI customers are ok with a single recommended lane provided we offer a documented fallback. We'll need a staging image we can smoke-test by Monday. Can you provide artifact tags?

marketplace-bot: Scheduled marketplace image rebuild for tags: redwood/rt:540-cuda12-4-stable and redwood/rt:legacy-525-cuda11-8 at 2026-03-29T02:00Z (ETA 45m).

jules: Kevin — I'll share the staging tags once the bot finishes. We'll also include a short snippet for how partners opt into the fallback variant in their deployment manifests.

anita: Ops checklist for publish: 1) vulnerability scan pass 2) KMS config doc 3) partner contract & comm signoff 4) support handoff (oncall schedule). Who owns #4?

sarah: @matt take #4 with ops support. I'll coordinate the comm signoff with @jules and legal for partner-facing wording.

matt: Ack. I'll open a runtime ticket with the explicit pins, kernel ranges, and the backport steps. ETA EOD Thu for the ticket + test plan.

evan: I'll run focused smoke tests on Monday against the staging image and post results. If we see >5% regression we'll escalate to vendor eng and attach perf traces.

jules: Draft comms timeline: Tue internal preview to partners -> Wed joint public announcement -> Thur marketplace listing live. If any blocker after QA on Mon, we delay announcement by 48h.

sarah: Summary/action items:
- @matt: runtime pins + backport/hotfix playbook (due Thu EOD)
- @evan: smoke perf runs on marketplace staging (Mon)
- @jules: partner comms + announcement copy (Mon Tue preview)
- @anita: security & publish checklist completion
- @kevin-acme: SI smoke validation and fallback acceptance
- marketplace-bot: image rebuild + tags (in flight)

sarah: Thanks all. Please add any partner-specific constraints in this thread so we have one place for the matrix. :thumbsup:
